modalLead: Two tiles in the health view that looked like the ones beside them and could not do what those do: one that did nothing when clicked, and one whose list no button on the page could shorten.

items.text: The Certificates tile opens the bookmarks behind it. It sat in a row of tiles that all filter the list and was the one that did nothing — the count is hosts, so clicking it now shows the bookmarks on them.

Missing preview has a button that can empty it. Re-check and Retest all ask whether a link still answers; neither asks its page for a title or an image, so the number never moved however often they were pressed. Fetch previews does exactly that, and says first that it is one request per bookmark.
